privacy: Country is a transient caller-provided presentation preference. This manifest defines locale selection only and must not persist requester identity, country analytics, payment state, or document history.
selectionRule: A caller may explicitly select any supported locale for its country. If no selection is provided, use the country default. If no country/locale is provided or a requested locale is unsupported, use en-US. Locale selection is request-scoped and is never persisted by Ricis.Core.
